row.team_price_text: Request Pricing (data-volume commitment, no per-user fees)
row.evidence: RelativityOne's help site documents only just-in-time provisioning ("JIT is only available with OpenID Connect and is not supported for SAML"); no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: RelativityOne is now sold as Relativity aiR: quote-only, priced on committed data volume with no per-user fees. No SCIM: users come in by JIT on OpenID Connect sign-in (Okta, Entra ID, Google and others; group claim mappings re-applied at each login), CSV import (User Import Application), invitations through Centralized Authentication, or the User Manager REST API (CRUD on users, included at no extra license cost). 'none' is by absence after searching the help-centre search, TOC and developer docs.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented in the RelativityOne help site or the developer platform; a help-centre search for 'SCIM' returns only the OpenID Connect page, which describes JIT provisioning. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: User Manager service (REST and .NET Kepler) supports CRUD on users plus helpers for user types, groups and workspace user lists. Open APIs are included at no additional license cost.

okta.notes: Relativity documents SSO with this IdP via OpenID Connect (with optional JIT); no SCIM provisioning. No IdP catalogue listing was found.

entra.notes: Relativity documents SSO with this IdP via OpenID Connect (with optional JIT); no SCIM provisioning. No IdP catalogue listing was found.

google.notes: Relativity documents SSO with this IdP via OpenID Connect (with optional JIT); no SCIM provisioning. No IdP catalogue listing was found.

fallbacks.other_sync: Relativity User and Group Synchronization app copies users and groups between Relativity instances; the Integration Points Entra ID provider imports custodian (entity) data, not users.
